rationale:
Issue #388 reports that from 2.12 onward a selector no longer finds <input> elements with non-empty value attributes inside a <form>, with a version-to-version reproducer. PR #389 and the single fix commit attribute this to two tree-builder mistakes introduced by optimization commit 66350af: insertForm called with onStack=false in the InBody paths (so <form> was never pushed on the open elements stack and children landed under <body>), and <input> losing its void-element handling so it fell through to the generic insert path. The production diff is confined to Sources/HtmlTreeBuilderState.swift and consists only of insertForm(startTag, false) -> true in the three InBody paths plus symmetric restoration of .input handling via insertEmpty with the existing type="hidden" framesetOk check; there is no formatting, docs, config, or refactor content, and no new production API is added. The minimized patch retains hunks 1 and 5 (one InBody insertForm correction and the nameSlice .input branch) and post_minimization_validation is PASS, with strict evidence for both the original and post-minimization matrices showing all gates green: build.both_versions, selectors.present_and_unique (3/3), trigger.buggy_differential reproducing all three declared selectors, trigger.fixed_clean, trigger.deterministic (5/5 fingerprint groups), full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers, and full_suite.fixed_all_green over 44 runs at 3 repetitions. The trigger tests are the upstream commit's own regression tests, altered only to replace force unwraps with optional chaining and XCTUnwrap, which converts process-terminating crashes into XCTest failures while preserving fixtures, selectors, and assertions; they exercise only pre-existing API (SwiftSoup.parse, select, children, attr, size). active_same_project_root_causes is empty and the root cause matches the single allowed verified issue key.

Issue #388 reports a 2.12 regression where a selector no longer finds <input> elements with non-empty value attributes, traced to inputs not being parsed as direct children of <form>. The fix commit 8fcecf0 (PR #389, 'fix_commit_to_issue' traceability, verified_fix_issue_numbers=[388]) addresses exactly that in Sources/HtmlTreeBuilderState.swift by (a) restoring insertForm(startTag, true) so the form is pushed on the open elements stack in InBody, and (b) restoring explicit <input> void-element handling via insertEmpty with the type="hidden" framesetOk check. The minimized production patch retains only hunks 1 and 5 — one insertForm false->true argument change and the nameSlice .input branch — both purely behavioral parser-state corrections in a single production file; there is no refactor, formatting, feature extension, doc, config, or test content in patches/minimized-production.patch. The curator-modified trigger (patches/trigger-tests-no-crash.patch vs patches/trigger-tests.patch) differs from upstream only by replacing two force-unwraps with optional chaining and one with XCTUnwrap; fixtures, selectors, and assertion values are identical, and the assertions exercise only pre-existing public API (SwiftSoup.parse, select, children, attr, size) — the fix introduces no new production symbol the trigger could depend on. Strict evidence for both the original and post-minimization revisions passes every gate: build.both_versions, trigger.buggy_differential with all three declared selectors reproduced, trigger.fixed_clean, trigger.deterministic (5/5 fingerprint groups), full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers, full_suite.fixed_all_green, and matrix.complete at 44 runs with 3 repetitions. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and the root cause matches the single allowed verified issue key.
